landing.heroSubtitle: Know how much you can safely spend — without thinking like an accountant.
landing.aiEmployee: Your AI employee sends invoices by voice or text, schedules meetings, tracks every unpaid invoice, and handles all the admin.
landing.stopGuessingBody: See exactly how much you can spend today, tomorrow, and next quarter — with live built-in tax estimates. No spreadsheets. No thinking like an accountant.
landing.aiEmployeeBody: Sends professional invoices (by text or voice), schedules client meetings, politely chases overdue payments, files expenses, and tracks your projects — while you do the creative work.
landing.oneDashboardBody: Clients • Projects • Revenue • Expenses • Quarterly taxes • Cash runway • AI task list.
landing.joinThousands: Join thousands of freelancers who finally feel in control.
landing.trialInfo: 14 days of full access • Cancel anytime
landing.irsDisclaimer: This is a high-level overview based on official IRS rules as of March 2026 (tax year 2025/2026). Tax laws change every year (earnings base, brackets, etc.). This is NOT tax advice. Estimates only — always verify at IRS.gov, with a CPA, or with tax software like TurboTax. Consult a tax professional. Non-compliance can result in penalties and interest.
